representative_schemes.selection_basis: best macro-F1 and lowest seed variance in Step 03_I
runner-up macro-F1, highest AUC in Step 03_I

shared.scheme_selection_rule: explicit user confirmation 2026-09-15 before any Step 04 analysis; all 15 models per scheme analysed (no checkpoint selection)
shared.perturbation_method: one channel at a time replaced by black pixels (identical to the black center-padding fill, in-distribution); applied identically to every scheme

deeplift_settings.channel_importance: mean share of summed |attribution| per channel per sample

shared.visual_example_rule: seed 42 / fold 1 model; first 2 correctly classified eval samples per class in dataset order (pre-specified, no cherry-picking)
